title: The Secret History
author: Donna Tartt
summary: A California student transfers to a small Vermont college and is admitted to an elite circle of classics students. We learn early that they have killed one of their own, and the book traces how it happened.
readIf: you like atmospheric campus novels, long and literary, where you know the crime from page one.
skipIf: you want a fast plot or characters who are easy to like.

pairings.reason: The same author's later novel, with the same rich prose and a young person trapped by one bad event.
A secret-society university story with a more supernatural, action-driven plot.
A short classic about beauty, influence and moral decay that clearly inspired this kind of story.
